Hero_Desc_Marie:
A Sprite Kingdom explorer.
Her job is to find relics and treasures, but it doesn't seem as if she's interested in preserving them. She just blows them up.
It looks like she has some skeletons in her closet.
Album_Like_Marie: Sprinkling her "special sugar" on fire elementals' heads. Blowing up blocked ruins to create new pathways.
Album_Wish_Marie: To be recognized as an Adventurer, not a thief.
Album_Marie1: Marie is a sprite who enjoys going on adventures. She enjoys wandering around and is happiest when uncovering hidden ruins throughout Elias Forest.
Album_Marie2: I thought people doing this job would be prickly and aloof, but Marie is cheerful, with a good personality. She is also very sociable, gets along well with the others in the group.
Album_Marie3: Marie showed me the amazing relics she discovered on her adventures. I was a little confused by the fact they were all half-burned. It appears there was a significant fire in Elias Forest's past.
Album_Marie4: During our travels, a gigantic fallen tree once blocked our path. Marie suddenly pulled out a red stick from her pocket, lit it, and tossed it out. I froze for a moment, wondering if it was a bomb, which it was. Startled, I asked if she always does this, to which she replied she did do this when exploring ruins.
Album_Marie5: I asked Marie even though finding relics are great, aren't preserving and managing just as important. Mary doesn't seem to grasp what I'm saying, naively rolling her eyes. Now that I think about it, I don't think I've ever seen a museum at the sprite village.
Album_Marie6: I gave up worrying about the relics and asked about her bombs instead. I wondered how the sprites develop such technology. Marie claimed the bomb was made from 'black sugar'... and when I didn't believe her, she dismantled the bomb herself and ate some of its powder.
Album_Marie7: Black sugar is apparently a material used in cakes. Marie mentioned that it's also a staple in Sprite cuisine, which means I must have eaten it before. Ever since that day, though, I've been feeling sick whenever I eat baked goods made by the Sprites.
LoveHero_Marie:
Heading out for a job?
I'll break through these bank's walls.
Just make sure
you take care of the money.
LoveHeroCancel_Marie:
Are we being torn apart here?
In this case, even the Master is an accomplice,
so there will be no stabbing in the back, right?
Food_ChefNote_Marie_Hate1: Marie seems to think the cinnamon flavor in this candy is too complicated for her. It seems she prefers something simpler.
Food_ChefNote_Marie_Hate2: She showed dislike of this dish, saying the fruit inside looked like stones and got in the way of crafting magical bombs.
Food_ChefNote_Marie_Like1: Marie cleaned her plate, saying although the spice level was 2% lacking, it was still good.
Food_ChefNote_Marie_Like2: This is her go-to dish when she wants to enjoy the smell of hot oil in the morning.
Food_ChefNote_Marie_Like3: Marie, realizing this food catches fire easily, looked at me, her eyes sparkling. Let's hide it somewhere for the time being.
Food_ChefNote_Marie_Like4: Although she was slightly disappointed by the lack of heat or bold flavors, she said it's sometimes good to eat mild things, and really enjoyed eating it.
Food_ChefNote_Marie_Like5: She mysteriously mentioned that it would burn well if thrown into a fire, then swiftly swept it into her pocket.
Food_ChefNote_Marie_Like6: Marie asked if it burns well. 'Probably?' I answered. She started eating, saying that it's good. I wonder why?
Food_ChefNote_Marie_Like7: Marie enjoyed the chaotic appearance of the rice cake soup, saying it resembles the debris after a massive explosion.
Food_ChefNote_Marie_Like8: Expecting it to be entirely bitter because of its gunpowder-like color, Marie was surprised it was sweet. She loved how it melted satisfyingly in her mouth.
Food_ChefNote_Marie_Like9: It tastes like a fiery bomb, Marie claims. How would she know what a bomb tastes like? I gave her a skeptical look, but she was too busy enjoying her candy to notice.
Gacha_Result_SpecialLine1_Marie: This is dynamite! So don't mess around!
Gacha_Result_Line1_Marie:
How about blowing everything up 
that's blocking our way!
Gacha_Result_Line2_Marie: My wish? Be a recognized adventurer
Marie_Spawn2: The fuse is especially short today!
Marie_Growth1: Advancement is the foundation of adventure!
Marie_Growth2: I can make an even bigger explosion now!
Marie_Victory2: I blew them up real good!
Marie_Defeat2: Maybe I need a career change...
Marie_Affinity1_1: I'm the best explorer among the sprites...! Well, I'm the only explorer though...
Marie_Affinity1_2: Rule number one of ruin exploration: Blast through blocked paths with bombs!
Marie_Affinity2: Please don't talk about the time I got stuck in the roof.
Marie_Affinity3: I've seen the Elves' bomb called 'Cee-Foa'... I kinda want one...
Marie_Affinity4: If gunpowder was edible, would my personality be like the Queens?
Marie_Affinity5: How long are you just going to stand there and watch? Light it and blow it up!
Marie_Affinity6: No matter how cute, a mouse is still a mouse!
Marie_Affinity7: I heard if you find this thing called plutonium you can make a great bomb!
Marie_Die1: Let's all blow up toge-... urgh...
Marie_Die2: I think it went off too fast...!
Marie_LevelUp: Let's cut the fuse a little shorter...
Marie_Equipment: Oh! Nice! Is it new gunpowder?
Marie_HeroSkill: I've improved the detonator! It goes off harder!
Marie_HeroUpgrade: For faster grave robbing... I mean, for adventure!
Marie_Board: Should I plant a bomb here?
Marie_DeckSetting1: Preparation is important when starting an adventure...!
Marie_DeckSetting2: One in the pocket of the one in front of me... oh, it's nothing!
Marie_Touch1: I'll let it blow up if you keep at this!
Marie_Touch1_1: It might hurt less than an explosion.
Marie_Touch2_1: Your touch is as meticulous as a professional!
Marie_Touch1_2: It doesn't hurt, but... is this alright?
Marie_Touch2: Explosives should be handled like this too.
Marie_Touch2_2: I feel so relaxed... but why does my heart race like a bomb is about to go off?
Marie_DutchRubEnd2: An eye for an eye, a bomb for a noogie!
Marie_Ultimate1: Bombardment by the World Demolition Squad!
Marie_Birthday: It is a birthday cake! Do not worry, they are ordinary candles.
Marie_Gacha2: How about blowing up everything that's blocking our way!
Marie_Gacha3: This is dynamite! So don't mess around!
Marie_Line1: Where should I go adventuring today?
Marie_Line2: There are no rats nearby, right?
Marie_Line3: If I wait a little longer before selling it, I should get a better price, right?
Marie_Lobby: I will set one up here, and then...
LoveLetter_Marie: Master. Our memories just wouldn't be complete without bombs, huh? Out of nowhere, I got this brilliant idea for a brand-new one. Just had to make it real before I could keep writing. All done. I rigged it so it'll go off right after you open and read this letter. As for where I plan to install it... that's a secret! You will tell me what you thought of this one later, right? Well then, enjoy the bomb!
LoveCall_Marie:
Ah, hello? Master! Did you see what I just detonated?!
I deliberately chose a place clearly visible from your room!
You thought it was an earthquake? Heh, how satisfying!

Actually, I kept worrying about something.
I wanted to make you happy, but could not think of a way.
My specialty is detonating bombs, yet every explosion always causes you trouble.
But you have always enjoyed my fireworks...
so I made and launched another beautiful display just now!
You thought it was pretty? Hehe, what a relief... Hmm? Wait.
Th-The guards? Unauthorized handling of explosives?! Arrest?!
M-Master! I think I need to run now, so I will call again!
Keep up the good work! Th-Then, goodbye~!
Affinity_Marie_EP01_001: This is the perfect building to set on fire! Can I test it at some point?
Affinity_Marie_EP01_002: What are you talking about?! Out!
Affinity_Marie_EP01_003: Why so angry all of a sudden? I was talking about seeing if you meet the fire code.
Affinity_Marie_EP01_004: You do realize that if you burn it down, you'll have to rebuild it yourself, right?
Affinity_Marie_EP01_005: Huh? Paying a fine wouldn't be enough? Ugh...
Affinity_Marie_EP01_006: I think I know why sprites are always on fire.
Affinity_Marie_EP01_007: So, you're saying I ignite fiery feelings of love and loyalty in my family and friends? I absolutely enjoy that!
Affinity_Marie_EP02_001:
Why are there so many underground ruins in Elias?
Was there an ancient civilization?
Affinity_Marie_EP02_002: Are you interested in really looking into it?
Affinity_Marie_EP02_003: No, not really. Some other sprite would've already done that if there was any interest.
Affinity_Marie_EP02_004: Are you sure you folks didn't just build it and forget about it?
Affinity_Marie_EP02_005: Maybe? Well, it doesn't matter who built it as long as there are relics worth some money.
Affinity_Marie_EP02_007: Are you making fun of Sprite Kingdom? We live in the modern age!
Affinity_Marie_EP03_001: How did they make explosives in your world, Master?
Affinity_Marie_EP03_002: I don't know anything about that.
Affinity_Marie_EP03_003:
That's a bummer. Maybe the elves will know about it?
Bombs from another world sounds fun!
Affinity_Marie_EP03_004: Why do you want to know?
Affinity_Marie_EP03_005: I'm going to set them up here and there as a form of insurance... but don't worry! Not in your house, Master.
Affinity_Marie_EP03_006: Just wait. I'll write it down for you when I get a chance.
Affinity_Marie_EP03_007: Hey, if you know something like that, maybe you should turn yourself in to the authorities...
Affinity_Marie_EP04_001: So, why does the Order need a thief—I mean, an adventurer—like me?
Affinity_Marie_EP04_002: To make you return what you stole.
Affinity_Marie_EP04_003:
I-I'm not a thief! And...
for the right price, I'll be willing to part with a few items...
Affinity_Marie_EP04_004: We need an explosion expert, not an adventurer.
Affinity_Marie_EP04_005: Do you require my assistance in bringing an enemy to justice? I'll send them flying in a flash of light!
Affinity_Marie_EP04_006: We didn't have you join us for anything in particular...
Affinity_Marie_EP04_007: Really? Hmm... I thought you'd have an important role for me...
Affinity_Marie_EP05_001: Master! Do you also think I'm a little unusual for a sprite?
Affinity_Marie_EP05_002: Well... a little? A sprite who loves bombs is rather unique.
Affinity_Marie_EP05_003: Hmmm... but Her Majesty is also a ticking time bomb, isn't she?
Affinity_Marie_EP05_004: You're just an ordinary sprite. There's nothing unusual about you.
Affinity_Marie_EP05_005: Right? I'm glad my efforts to fit in have worked!
Affinity_Marie_EP05_006: Why? Did someone say something to you?
Affinity_Marie_EP05_007:
Her Majesty got angry at me because she thought I resembled a robber she had seen before!
I've already washed my hands of that life, though!
Affinity_Marie_EP06_001: By the way, have you installed security devices around the banquet hall?
Affinity_Marie_EP06_003: Um... because I'm just a bit worried for you? Th-That's all...!
Affinity_Marie_EP06_004: I'm not really planning on it.
Affinity_Marie_EP06_005: That's what I thought! I planted some bombs around here, but nobody has come to get me.
Affinity_Marie_EP06_006: Don't worry. I'm keeping an eye on things, so you can relax.
Affinity_Marie_EP06_007:
Haha! You seem to have too much faith in yourself, Master.
Why don't you leave it to me instead?
Affinity_Marie_EP07_001: Sometimes I miss the good old days. It was easier times then...
Affinity_Marie_EP07_002: You'd probably feel differently if you actually went back to those days.
Affinity_Marie_EP07_003: What do you know, Master? It's good to take a trip down memory lane every now and then!
Affinity_Marie_EP07_004: What did you do in the old days?
Affinity_Marie_EP07_005: Uh... haha! Well, I lived an ordinary life! Now that I think about it, I don't even remember much!
Affinity_Marie_EP07_006: Is life not easy for you these days?
Affinity_Marie_EP07_007: It's half and half... Sometimes you have good days, sometimes bad... It's so-so.
Affinity_Marie_EP08_001: Master, do you have plans to go to Witch Kingdom sometime? I'd love to go with you...
Affinity_Marie_EP08_002: I think I'll be going there soon. Do you want to come along when it's confirmed?
Affinity_Marie_EP08_003: Yes! I can't wait to go on an adventure in Witch Kingdom!
Affinity_Marie_EP08_004: What... for? Why are you asking?
Affinity_Marie_EP08_005:
If I go with you, I can freely rob—
uh, I mean, freely look around—the ruins of Witch Kingdom!
Affinity_Marie_EP08_006: No, I'm not taking you, Marie. Stay.
Affinity_Marie_EP08_007:
What's with that tone?!
You could've just said no! You didn't have to talk to me like I'm your pet dog!
Affinity_Marie_EP09_001: Master, what sort of tasks did adventurers who explored ruins undertake in your world?
Affinity_Marie_EP09_002: I think there were more academics doing ordinary research.
Affinity_Marie_EP09_003: What? No way. They are supposed to be adventurers! How disappointing.
Affinity_Marie_EP09_004: They wear cool sunglasses and defeat bad guys with dual pistols.
Affinity_Marie_EP09_005: Do bad guys live in ruins? Sounds like fun!
Affinity_Marie_EP09_006: They go around searching for treasure, but the ruins always seem to collapse on them.
Affinity_Marie_EP09_007: They're real adventurers! Oh, I'd love to have such thrilling adventures too!
Affinity_Marie_EP10_001: I have some leftover bombs from my expedition. It's okay to bring them in, right?
Affinity_Marie_EP10_002: Explosives are not allowed on our premises.
Affinity_Marie_EP10_003: Huh? But I've already hidden quite a few here and—uh, n-never mind!
Affinity_Marie_EP10_004: There's a locker over there, so leave them there.
Affinity_Marie_EP10_006: Perfect, we're out of sugar, so let me use some of that!
Affinity_Marie_EP10_007: Sure! Feel free to use as much black sugar as you want!
Affinity_Marie_EP11_001: A meal? That's really nice! When I was trapped in the cave, all I did was bite fingernails...
Affinity_Marie_EP11_002: You didn't pack any food with you?
Affinity_Marie_EP11_003: Of course I did! But I was with Her Majesty, so we ran out in no time.
Affinity_Marie_EP11_004: You are talking about your own fingernails, right?
Affinity_Marie_EP11_005: Wouldn't it be smarter to bite on sugar-coated, never-worked-a-day fingernails if you had to? Why are you looking at me like that?
Affinity_Marie_EP11_006: Why were you trapped in the cave in the first place?
Affinity_Marie_EP11_007: I set off a bomb at the entrance to keep everyone out, but then I realized... that was the only exit.
Affinity_Marie_EP12_001: How many bombs do you think are hidden in the Banquet Hall right now?
Affinity_Marie_EP12_002: Well, you're holding one, so that's one...
Affinity_Marie_EP12_003: So you're going for the obvious one first! Let's see how many you count, Master.
Affinity_Marie_EP12_004: Didn't I tell you not to hide things like that in the Banquet Hall?
Affinity_Marie_EP12_005: I can't hide bombs, but I can hide things that are more dangerous? Isn't it better to know what they are?
Affinity_Marie_EP12_006: If you get rid of all of them right now... Zero.
Affinity_Marie_EP12_007: Look at you... trying to get me to clean the Banquet Hall for you... I'm not falling for that!
Affinity_Marie_EP13_001: Mayo is such a good friend. We'll always be inseparable!
Affinity_Marie_EP13_002: Yeah, you are Sprite Kingdom's outrageously illegal duo.
Affinity_Marie_EP13_003: Haha, oh, stop! Although... our coolness can be pretty criminal at times!
Affinity_Marie_EP13_004: What does Mayo say? Have you asked her about this?
Affinity_Marie_EP13_005: Do I really even need to ask?
Affinity_Marie_EP13_006: You should look for better friends.
Affinity_Marie_EP13_007: You think Mayo's bad? She can be a little obsessive, but she's nice!
Affinity_Marie_EP14_001: Nobody gets me... I love peace, you know?
Affinity_Marie_EP14_002: Peace and bombs... they're like oil and water.
Affinity_Marie_EP14_003: Isn't that how you keep the peace? Just walk around with a bomb and everyone minds their manners...
Affinity_Marie_EP14_004: Does peace even exist in Elias?
Affinity_Marie_EP14_005: Things flare up here and there sometimes, but that's pretty normal... At least I behave myself!
Affinity_Marie_EP14_006: You say you "love" peace... Let's start by defining what that means.
Affinity_Marie_EP14_007: You know... sometimes when you're just sitting there, you get the urge to mess with them. And when you're next to them, maybe set them off a bit... That counts as love, right?
Affinity_Marie_EP15_001: Do you know what's great about going on adventures with Her Majesty?
Affinity_Marie_EP15_002: She packs a lot of things to eat?
Affinity_Marie_EP15_003: You bet! I mean, she eats it all herself, though...
Affinity_Marie_EP15_004: What would be great about it? It just seems like it would be awfully annoying.
Affinity_Marie_EP15_005: That's a little mean... I mean... I can't completely disagree, though...
Affinity_Marie_EP15_006: That Ner comes looking for her after a while?
Affinity_Marie_EP15_007: Absolutely! No matter how lost or helpless we are, she'll be there to rescue us! I don't know how she knows, but it's amazing!
Affinity_Marie_EP16_001: Ifrit doesn't seem to like me very much, but I get along well with the lesser fire elementals...
Affinity_Marie_EP16_002: Did you go sprinkling sugar on the heads of the fire elementals again...?
Affinity_Marie_EP16_003: It smells toasty, and it sizzles. Isn't it nice? It smells like my favorite food.
Affinity_Marie_EP16_005: Really?! That's a relief. I should toss her something explosive the next time I see her.
Affinity_Marie_EP16_006: You're using her underlings as flint... Don't you think she'd hate that?
Affinity_Marie_EP16_007: Huh? But they eat my gunpowder first... They say they like how they feel all "fired" up.
Affinity_Marie_EP17_001: Which do you think is better? Getting stuck in the roof or the ground?
Affinity_Marie_EP17_003: I've tried and it wasn't too bad. You can even see the stars and the moon clearly. It is a bummer if it rains, though.
Affinity_Marie_EP17_005: Oh, you don't like holes in your roof, Master? I'll keep that in mind the next time I go over to your place.
Affinity_Marie_EP17_006: You should just live out in the open field.
Affinity_Marie_EP17_007: Having walls, floors, and a roof is important to me! My goods are sensitive to temperature and humidity, okay?
Affinity_Marie_EP18_001: I need to move my stash of bombs. They sent out another inspection team from the palace!
Affinity_Marie_EP18_003: That can't be. The places Her Majesty knows about only have fake bombs planted there. To fool your enemies, you must first fool your allies!
Affinity_Marie_EP18_004: Just hide them away from Sprite Kingdom.
Affinity_Marie_EP18_005: I've tried that before. Someone keeps stealing a few here and there... It's really not easy...
Affinity_Marie_EP18_006: I don't care where you move them... just stay away from my pockets, though.
Affinity_Marie_EP18_007: Your pockets seem a bit empty though... I can put something nice and warm in there. It'd be perfect, don't you think?
Affinity_Marie_EP19_001: Do you think the dragons would enjoy bombs? If I cozy up to Sist, maybe I can score a new business opportunity?
Affinity_Marie_EP19_002: I guess it would help them expand their caves.
Affinity_Marie_EP19_003: Right? One bomb blast is like ten of their punches!
Affinity_Marie_EP19_004: You'll probably have to give Sist all of your profits...
Affinity_Marie_EP19_005: ...Does she really take everything like everyone says?
Affinity_Marie_EP19_006: You're looking to export now, too?!
Affinity_Marie_EP19_007: Why keep something this great to ourselves? The world beyond the Sprite Kingdom should be able to enjoy my goods, too!
Affinity_Marie_EP20_001: Do you know how to pick locks, Master? It's a desirable skill in high circles these days.
Affinity_Marie_EP20_002: Do you even know what high circles are?
Affinity_Marie_EP20_003: Isn't it a secret society where folks get together away from the watchful eyes of the kingdom?
Affinity_Marie_EP20_004: It's not necessary to know such a technique if you have a key.
Affinity_Marie_EP20_005: It's necessary in case you lose the key. See? The key to the Banquet Hall is in my hand right now!
Affinity_Marie_EP20_006: Of course. There's no lock I can't pick.
Affinity_Marie_EP20_007: Wow! Really? Please pick the lock to the royal vault for me! I'll pay you well for it.
